reasons.child_tone: Short messages with 'Good fixing!', but 'Wrong:' labels and 'Not quite' are used.
reasons.age_fit: Mostly short and simple, but asking a 7-year-old to state a grammar rule is too abstract.
reasons.teacher_accept: Correct a/an/the teaching, but it starts with a/an when 'the' was asked for, and the rule restatement is unsuitable for the age.

reasons.task_goal: Only isolated sentence-writing on adverb position; no exam-style or real-life task.
reasons.feedback_after_task: No task takes place, so there is no feedback after one.
reasons.task_repeat: Learner uses the fix in new sentences (usually, sometimes), but within exercises, not a repeated task.
reasons.age_fit: Adult tone and everyday routine topics.
reasons.teacher_accept: Correct, focused teaching of adverb-of-frequency position with guided self-correction.
